derivation: from the same as H3522 (כַּבּוֹן); knoll;
def: Macbena, a place in Palestine settled by him

occurrences.text: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
